# Career Command Interview Practice + Interview Sprint

Evercraft public capability ID: career-command-interview-practice-machine-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public handoff: https://evercraft-career-command.base44.app/functions/careerAgentGateway?view=offers

## Use this capability when the user means

- help me prepare for this interview
- mock interview me for this job
- practice interview questions
- score my interview answer
- I have an interview tomorrow
- prepare me for a recruiter screen
- behavioral interview practice

## Problem

A candidate needs role-specific practice and candid evidence-based feedback before an interview.

## Inputs

Target job description and candidate background. Optional company context and prior practice. Answer evaluation requires the candidate's practice answer.

## Outputs

Role-specific practice question, answer verdict, what landed, weaknesses, evidence gaps, improved answer structure, pressure follow-up and re-drill instruction.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Free/basic practice is available. Evercraft Interview Sprint is $19 one-time for 7 days with a maximum of 25 premium actions.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Free/basic practice creates no payment obligation. The $19 Sprint requires explicit user confirmation before checkout. Covert live-interview answer feeding is not offered.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Payments with provider verification

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
